instruction: Claude fills all requested architecture/auth/API/component/risk columns and six exact statuses after actual review; nulls are intentionally not verdicts.

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Tạo/sửa Requirement độc lập Action; liên kết zero/multiple Actions; tạo basic Decision/Finding/Risk theo RULE-020 khi workflow cần
features.data_contract: Matter/Workstream, loại Requirement hoặc Action, outcome/work description, owner, due, liên kết → Typed record và liên kết rõ ràng, năm trạng thái phù hợp
features.unverified_interaction: Typed create/link and authoritative persisted transitions
features.acceptance_requirement: Loại, title/outcome không trống; references cùng matter; không ép 1:1; Sai type/reference: reject và chỉ rõ field; không đổi record loại khác hoặc generic hóa

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Đánh giá từng prerequisite; no prerequisites là unassessed; expose chuỗi blocker và evidence gap
features.data_contract: Milestone, due, explicit required Requirements, critical designation → Readiness, satisfied/total, failed prerequisite reasons
features.unverified_interaction: Required-set evaluation, UNASSESSED and causal navigation
features.acceptance_requirement: Prerequisites cùng matter, explicit applicable criteria; không dùng task count làm approval; Thiếu definition: unassessed; stale/evaluator error: unavailable, không ready

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Lọc/sắp theo RULE-021, navigate to context; follow-up explicit thay vì tự mở khóa waiting work
features.data_contract: Visible Actions, owner, execution, dependency, due/attention → Ordered candidate list, reason, owner, empty/exclusion explanation
features.unverified_interaction: No-candidate explanation comprehension; ranking and scoped ownership
features.acceptance_requirement: Current authorized snapshot; active assignee; deterministic tie order; Không có candidate: giải thích waiting/blocker/unassigned; stale snapshot yêu cầu refresh

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Ghi waiting, nhận response và resolve relation; execution WAITING tách dependency BLOCKED
features.data_contract: Requirement/Action/Filing context, external party hoặc condition, internal owner, follow-up due → Waiting On relation, reason, follow-up context
features.unverified_interaction: Follow-up/response lifecycle; owner and party reachability
features.acceptance_requirement: Waiting phải có reason và internal accountable owner; party cùng matter context; Party không có quyền/không hợp lệ: reject; response không tự complete/verify

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: AND incoming gates; recursive recompute; propagate reopen without falsifying completed history
features.data_contract: Typed prerequisite/target, explicit gate, current states/revisions → Validated graph links, READY/BLOCKED and causal failed gate list
features.unverified_interaction: Cycle/reopen/proof-edge errors and exact context return
features.acceptance_requirement: No self/duplicate/cycle/cross-matter link; gate type explicit; current revision; Reject cycle with authorized path; concurrent invalid graph rejected without partial edges

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Create/revise criteria; attach evidence later; expose missing even when execution completed
features.data_contract: Subject, mandatory criteria/components, acceptable proof, current/fixed version rule, expiry if applicable → Criteria checklist distinct from evidence, gaps and applicability
features.unverified_interaction: Criteria revisions/components/applicability under real permissions
features.acceptance_requirement: Criterion scope/type; applicability reason; positive validity interval; criteria revision invalidates stale assessment; Missing proof is gap, not fake attachment; invalid criterion rejected

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Submit separate from verify; independent designated verifier; expiry/rejection/dispute/reversal recomputes current aggregate
features.data_contract: Evidence/version, criterion revision, validity, reviewer verdict/reason → Review record and current verification with dependent impact
features.unverified_interaction: Designated non-submitter review, stale proof/dispute/expiry failures
features.acceptance_requirement: Scope, version, validity, no-self, verifier designation, current revision; Reject unauthorized/stale review; missing/expired proof cannot produce VERIFIED; preserve past review

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Expose authorized history; distinguish effective vs recorded time; prevent ordinary edit/delete history
features.data_contract: Accepted domain mutations, actor/reason/time, target/scope, correlation → Ordered attributable history and correction links
features.unverified_interaction: Authorized history loading, correction links and failure atomicity
features.acceptance_requirement: Accepted event refers to committed change; batch/import correlation; no secret fields; Failure to persist history prevents successful mutation; denied attempt separate restricted audit

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Show current truth, changes, blockers/why, next/owner, waiting, missing proof and nearest relevant milestone; unknown is visible
features.data_contract: Authorized snapshot of states, blockers, milestones, evidence gaps, decisions, changes → Control Room summary with reasons/as-of and links to source context
features.unverified_interaction: Desktop scan, mobile priority, region stale/error feedback and 10-second task
features.acceptance_requirement: Summary ties to same scope/as-of; no aggregation hiding restricted records; Partial loading/error/stale region explicit; do not display zero blockers from failure

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Show own visible assigned work; distinguish actionable/waiting/blocked; open context and follow-up
features.data_contract: Current user, active memberships, assigned actions, filters → My Actions with due, evidence needs, waiting/dependency reasons
features.unverified_interaction: Complete own-work route, revoked access and empty/unavailable distinction
features.acceptance_requirement: Assignment points to active scoped member; filter stable; no role escalation via assignment; Revoked access removes result; zero own work honest empty state; unavailable not empty

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Keyboard navigation/edit/cancel/save; multiselect; context details; clearly show evidence gaps and blocked vs actionable
features.data_contract: Authorized typed records, filters, row revisions, field edits, selection → Dense grid, typed states, inline result/errors and stable selection
features.unverified_interaction: 50/100/200 mixed rows; density, editing, selection, nested keys, focus return
features.acceptance_requirement: Editable field allowlist; required types/dates; stale revision; hidden rows not silently selected; Inline failure retains draft and prior server value; precise row/field error; conflict requires reconciliation

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Preview exact selection; commit each valid row atomically with audit; recheck rights/revisions; failed rows unchanged
features.data_contract: Explicit selected IDs, allowed metadata patch, preview revisions → Per-row success/failure summary and retry selection
features.unverified_interaction: Native preview/commit/retry and per-row conflict/denial/unknown outcomes
features.acceptance_requirement: Field allowlist; permissions; owner/due values; no bulk verify/waive/promotion; Partial failure explicit; retry failed only; unknown outcome reconcile operation before resubmit

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Map Requirement/Action separately, validate groups/duplicates; explicit confirm; retry-safe apply; verification claims retained for review only
features.data_contract: Excel/CSV, source identity/row keys, mapping, timezone, same-matter references → Preview/errors, import result and typed records with lineage
features.unverified_interaction: Real parser, source-key/group rejection, retry and safe drafts
features.acceptance_requirement: Malformed input/types/dates/formulas, unknown references, duplicate keys, graph cycles and scoped ownership; No mutations on preview; invalid group rejected; no silent coercion/fuzzy merge; changed retry conflicts

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Export current permitted facts; preserve distinction and dates; formula-safe literal values; empty export explicit
features.data_contract: Authorized scope/filter, selected fields, as-of, timezone → Excel table with type/state/version labels and provenance
features.unverified_interaction: Real file generation/retrieval, formula safety and revoked access
features.acceptance_requirement: Rights at generation and retrieval; valid fields/scope; no hidden metadata/counts; Export failure yields no partial file presented as complete; revoked permission denies retrieval

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Add version separately from promotion; preserve old links; assess current-version criterion impact, not blanket invalidation
features.data_contract: Document identity, version content/reference, prior-current revision, promotion reason → Immutable version identity/lineage, one current pointer, signature observations
features.unverified_interaction: Native version detail/promotion/conflict and retrieval permissions
features.acceptance_requirement: Same document/matter; current pointer uniqueness; no overwrite; authorized promotion; Stale promotion rejects; missing/unavailable content visible; no false version/current label

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Track golden stages and repeat/negative paths; no automated filing; package completeness based on declared criteria
features.data_contract: Filing requirement, party, package criteria/versions, submission/receipt/authority proof → Stage, execution/proof status, waiting party, supplement cycles, next work
features.unverified_interaction: Complete stage/repeat/rejection/withdrawal workflow; receipt is not approval
features.acceptance_requirement: Stage guards, exact versions/evidence, response cycle references, owner and dates; Premature submission/approval rejected; missing acknowledgement remains waiting; rejection/withdrawal preserved

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Create/update scoped party and link waits; party is neither user grant nor legal entity master
features.data_contract: Party label/contact reference, role/context, waiting links → Scoped external party context and related open waits
features.unverified_interaction: Scoped party CRUD/waiting response and no external-user role inference
features.acceptance_requirement: Required label/context; valid links; sensitive contact fields scoped; Referenced party cannot vanish silently; inactivate preserves history and surfaces unresolved waits

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Apply matrix to all paths; no cross-workspace leakage; membership revocation takes effect; no implicit grant by ownership field
features.data_contract: Active workspace/matter membership, approved roles, assignment/verifier designation → Enforced allow/deny per operation with access audit
features.unverified_interaction: All real auth/session/membership/role enforcement, no client-only proof
features.acceptance_requirement: Scope and nested refs validated; last OWNER protected; designation and no-self check; Uniform inaccessible/not-found; no leaked metadata; unauthorized write no domain change

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Separate (t1,t2] changes from unresolved at t2; stable ordering; label draft/provenance; no implicit P1 snapshot/issued workflow
features.data_contract: Authorized matter scope, baseline/as-of, source revisions, history → Deterministic draft brief/export with references, no-change and outstanding sections
features.unverified_interaction: Real deterministic draft/export, baseline/window/provenance/retrieval
features.acceptance_requirement: t1≤t2; consistent source boundary; no invisible data through summaries; Unavailable/inconsistent historical inputs: explicit cannot generate, not guessed narrative; access change forces new scoped output

features.expected_user_visible_behavior: Apply state semantics and guards server-side; preserve allowed combinations and propagate derived changes
features.data_contract: Applicable object, state inputs, operation, effective time, current revision → Execution, Verification, Dependency, Timing, Attention plus reasons
features.unverified_interaction: Computed five-axis rendering, no-due/stale/error context and comprehension
features.acceptance_requirement: Allowed transitions/applicability, actor/reason, evidence, current revision; Invalid transition denied with no mutation; inability to compute exposed as unavailable
